evidence.observation: Pressure was 3.007 Torr at approximately 100 sccm Ar before growth.
Pressure rose progressively during growth from 3.018 Torr at 2520 s to 3.509 Torr despite unchanged temperature and Ar setpoints.
Temperature is 750.0 °C and Ar is 100.4 sccm, closely matching setpoints; neither explains the sustained pressure rise.
Exhaust O2 sensor is not installed; null O2 readings do not verify atmosphere purity.

args.missing_evidence: Independent atmosphere/O2 measurement is required to verify growth conditions; leak testing and exhaust conductance/pumping checks are needed to distinguish causes of the pressure rise. Sample characterization is not yet available.
